claims.assertion: Mari Swa says she cannot know what 3I/ATLAS is and argues its public narrative matters more than the object; she speculates it could test reactions or normalize extraterrestrial ideas, possibly serving a staged-invasion agenda.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She presents these as possibilities and says she cannot determine the object's nature.

claims.assertion: Swaruu de Erra says some early spacefaring civilizations hollow metallic asteroids and install engines and a cockpit, using the asteroid as a low-cost, impact-resistant, camouflaged craft.
claims.speaker: Swaruu de Erra, quoted by Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: This general claim is not presented as identifying 3I/ATLAS.

review_flags: The source explicitly says the speakers cannot determine the object's nature and includes speculation about staged alien scenarios.
coverage_gaps: The video also discusses alleged spacecraft traffic near Earth and questions the motives of NASA's public reporting.
